mapper.select: SELECT pvs.id, pvs.patient_id, p.name AS patient_name, pvs.record_date, pvs.blood_pressure_systolic, pvs.blood_pressure_diastolic, CONCAT(pvs.blood_pressure_systolic, '/', pvs.blood_pressure_diastolic) AS blood_pressure, pvs.blood_sugar, pvs.blood_sugar_type, CASE pvs.blood_sugar_type WHEN 'fasting' THEN '空腹' WHEN 'postprandial' THEN '餐后' WHEN 'random' THEN '随机' ELSE pvs.blood_sugar_type END AS blood_sugar_type_name, pvs.remarks FROM patient_vital_signs pvs LEFT JOIN patient p ON pvs.patient_id = p.id WHERE pvs.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patient_vital_signs (patient_id, record_date, blood_pressure_systolic, blood_pressure_diastolic, blood_sugar, blood_sugar_type, remarks) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{recordDate}, #{bloodPressureSystolic}, #{bloodPressureDiastolic}, #{bloodSugar}, #{bloodSugarType}, #{remarks})
